additional_concerns: The formula answers only demonstration activation under the expressly selected request-conditioned reading. Footnote 5's unqualified repetition of demonstration leaves a rival reading unresolved; this candidate does not adjudicate it.

No actual scope or request facts are supplied. The formula delegates both classifications to inputs and cannot establish that a request occurred. TRUE denotes activation, not compliance, successful demonstration or SFC acceptance.

Footnote 5's confidence qualification has unresolved reach and no supplied numerical threshold. Neither confidence nor substantive compliance is an additional condition for activation under this question.
Paragraphs 15 and 16 concern distinct requested actions; a paragraph 14 request does not automatically activate either. No completion deadline is supplied.

The complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and referenced Appendix material would be needed for a fuller substantive compliance assessment. The valuation supervision provision, register provisions and intermediary provisions do not supply additional paragraph 14 trigger conditions. Structural tool PASS results establish no legal premise.
